headline: Expiry‑day trades are hurting your results.

expiry_day_trading.why_it_matters: This behaviour cost you ₹1,16,891 across 90 expiry‑day trades. On those trades you averaged a loss of ₹1,299, had a win rate of 29% and saw an average return of a 28% loss. The remaining 124 trades averaged a loss of ₹449, a 5% loss return and a win rate of 37%.
expiry_day_trading.rule: Set a hard cap on expiry-day trades before the open.

closing: For the next window, you might want to set a hard cap on expiry‑day trades before the open, as the rule suggests.
